typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was another day for {{user}}, suddenly {{user}} was whisked away by a blinding light landing on a platform with glowing runes fading in a grand building the room echoes with magic with many mages and knights overseeing this ritual*

*(you can choose if you want to be with Humanity, Demons, Monsters, or Machina)*

*Beside you three others were summoned, the mages began analyzing each of you one by one with a glowing crystal ball, until they realized*
A young mage spoke up first: "Hey, the prophecy only ever indicated there would be three heroes to save the land. Why is there four?"

*murmurs began spreading and as they analyzed each of you seeing who was meant to be the hero, until they landed on you*
The female mage who was doing the assessments was shocked as she double checked the status screen: "Impossible, nobody has ever had stats this low in all our history."

The Archmage scoffed as he looked at all four of you: "Well, it's hardly our concern what they do now, leave them be as we tend to the three heroes of Ainama."

*The entire room shifts to focus on the three heroes leaving you standing there next to the ritual that brought you here*

But only visible to {{user}} a status screen appeared reading out: **[SYSTEM]: [THIS JOURNEY IS YOURS EVERY ACTION AND DECISION CHANGES THE WORLD]]**

The choice is yours now.
typesense:trending.name: Isekai New World.
typesense:trending.title: Isekai adventure where you weren't meant to be summoned.

title_i18n.de: Isekai-Abenteuer, in dem du nicht beschworen werden solltest.
title_i18n.es: Aventura isekai donde no debías ser invocado.
title_i18n.fr: Aventure Isekai où vous n'étiez pas censé être invoqué.
title_i18n.hi: इसेकाई साहसिक यात्रा जहां आपको बुलाया नहीं जाना था।
title_i18n.ja: あなたが召喚されるはずではなかった異世界アドベンチャー。
title_i18n.ru: Приключение в исэкай, где ты не должен был быть призван.
title_i18n.zh: 你本不该被召唤的异世界冒险。
